item.title: Why Machiavellian Manipulators Are So Hard to Catch (And How to Spot Them)
item.description: It is notoriously difficult to catch a Machiavellian master manipulator because their tactics rely on calculated deception, deep cynicism, and a strategic separation of emotion from action.
